note: Display layers for the web map only. Counts and areas come from the analysis files, not from these images.

flood.method: classes 1 flooded, 2 persistent water, 3 water lost, 4 not assessed; reprojected to EPSG:3857 with nearest-neighbour resampling (rasterio calculate_default_transform), written as a paletted PNG with index 0 transparent

base.method: R=SWIR1 G=NIR B=Red, linear stretch as DATA.md (2nd-98th percentile), 8-bit; reprojected to EPSG:3857 at 80 m with bilinear resampling; progressive JPEG quality 80

slider.method: R=SWIR1 G=NIR B=Red, same stretch as DATA.md, native 30 m UTM grid, no reprojection, JPEG quality 88

outline.method: pixel outlines of data/flood/analysis_area.tif, merged, simplified with a 30 m tolerance (shapely), converted to WGS84
